svg.title: Scrapy: web-data operations
svg.desc: Turn web sources into owned artifacts and versioned datasets. Collect web content reliably and keep what was collected: the files, the records, and the evidence of how they were produced. Workflow: Choose a cataloged source, then Pass the policy and egress gate, then Crawl, fetch, or render, then Classify and store artifacts, then Publish a dataset version, then Search and fetch records.
